response.sql: SELECT B.BOOK_ID AS bookId, B.ISBN AS isbn, B.TITLE AS title, COUNT(L.LOAN_ID) AS loanCount FROM TB_BOOK AS B LEFT JOIN TB_LOAN AS L ON B.BOOK_ID = L.BOOK_ID LEFT JOIN TB_CATEGORY AS C ON B.CATEGORY_CD = C.CATEGORY_CD WHERE B.LOAN_YN = 'Y' AND DATE(L.LOAN_DATE) BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY B.BOOK_ID, B.ISBN, B.TITLE, C.CATEGORY_NM ORDER BY loanCount DESC LIMIT 10
